meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按计划分步执行代码任务并设置审查节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在独立会话中按计划逐步执行并接受审查
copy.tagline_en: Execute implementation plans step by step with review checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to execute a written plan in separate sessions with review checkpoints

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先加载并审查一份书面实施计划，然后按步骤执行每个任务，并在完成后报告。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一份书面实施计划，并希望它在一个独立会话中执行时触发。

say.text: 请执行这个实施计划，按步骤完成所有任务。
say.note: Claude 会加载计划并开始执行。

say.text: 审查这个计划，如果有问题先提出来。
say.note: Claude 会先审查计划，再决定是否继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude loads and critically reviews a written implementation plan, then executes each task step by step, and reports when complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a written implementation plan and want Claude to execute it in a separate session with review checkpoints.

say_en.text: Please execute this implementation plan and complete all tasks step by step.
say_en.note: Claude will load the plan and start execution.

say_en.text: Review this plan and raise any concerns before starting.
say_en.note: Claude will review the plan first, then decide whether to proceed.
